title: Copernicus Marine ocean datasets
description: Live catalogue of ocean observations, reanalyses and forecasts. Search and describe a specific dataset before requesting a spatial and temporal subset.

variables.name: Ocean physical and biogeochemical variables
variables.description: Examples include temperature, salinity, currents, chlorophyll and oxygen; actual variables and coverage depend on the selected dataset.

access.authentication: Catalogue searches are public; downloads use the user's Copernicus Marine account

limitations: This summary is not a complete static inventory: query the live Copernicus catalogue.
The server downloads bounded subsets; it does not calculate spatial or temporal averages or select depth levels.
NetCDF and Zarr are supported; CSV depends on Toolbox support and the requested dataset.
